flags.message: Decisive forward signal from outside the provisioned baseline: this petition asks to be held for Nos. 26-360 (FedEx v. Watt) and 26-387 (Kellogg v. Reichert), both from the Sixth Circuit's Reichert decision; supremecourt.gov shows respondent waivers in both (Sept 24 and 25, 2026) and no distribution yet. The corpus carries both as open evt-petition-disposition events (dockets 9026000360 and 9026000387), so the three cells' outcomes are coupled and should be read together when scored.
